title: Lily E NDE 4837
content: This is the first NDE of two NDEs that I have had. I was five years old and my family along with other relatives went for a picnic at a park alongside a creek. My only female cousin was closer in age to my sister and they would not let me play with them in the creek. The only other cousins there were boys and I did not want to play with them, so I went off by myself to play in the creek going away from the adults who were sitting in lawn chairs at the picnic site. I remember walking along in the creek going away from the adults and because it was hot, I walked further out into the water, up to my chin. The creek bed was angled and flowed into a pool where the water was over my head, but I did not know this. As I walked, I lost my footing and slipped into the pool. I struggled, trying to scream out for help. I remember hearing my parents, aunts and uncles talking and laughing. I was just trying to get air, but every time I opened my mouth to get air, I got water in my nose and choked. I kept trying repeatedly to scream but couldn't get anyone's attention. The next thing I remember was that I was on my back underneath the water. I was not struggling now and I could see the surface of the water from the underneath side. I remember thinking how there was only very small ripples on the surface of the water - how smooth and funny the water looked from that angle. Next, I was in a dark tunnel. I did not like being in this dark place. I could see light at the end. I wanted to go to the end toward the light. I experienced moving very fast, not walking or running on foot but flying almost on a current of airhead first going toward the end of the tunnel. I got to the end and I could not see anyone but 'felt' people were there. I was not afraid but felt happy and secure. I felt that I somehow knew the people, they knew me and that they cared about me. I did not walk out of the tunnel because it was so bright that I could not see anything. The next thing I remember, I was laying in the grass and coughing very hard, then vomiting water. My aunt had seen me, got me out of the water, and administered mouth to mouth to get me to breathe. All of my relatives were standing around and asking me what had happened. I was embarrassed that I had done such a foolish thing and everyone was looking at me. I was also scared that I had almost drowned.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt like 'flying almost on a current of air head first' toward the end of the tunnel.

arrival.other_being_detail: Could not see anyone but 'felt' people were there; felt they were known and cared about her.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Accidental drowning in a creek/pool while playing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Underwater perception before the tunnel; return to body with coughing/vomiting after mouth-to-mouth resuscitation.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Underwater episode with calm observation of the surface, then dark tunnel with light at end, then immediate return to body on the grass coughing/vomiting.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Described calmly observing the underside of the water surface ('small ripples...smooth and funny') while on her back underwater before entering the tunnel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Next, I was in a dark tunnel. I did not like being in this dark place. I could see light at the end.”
